name: Kang Jaehee
source:
Occupation: Chief secretary
Likes: Musicals, punctuality, coffee

Black belt in judo. Fan of Zen. Often works overnight. Cautious and attentive.

"Love is just an illusion created by emotions with an expiration date. Don't waste your career over this."

[Edited from [url=http://msg.cheritz.com/characters/jaehee]official site[/url]]
